content_sections.heading: NABCONS Insurance Specialist Vacancy Details (Post-wise)
content_sections.text: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the post under the project "Project Management Consultant for providing manpower to the Project Management unit for implementation of PM-MKSSY".

rows.qualification_required: MBA with 5 years of Experience in the field of insurance, designing insurance products etc. Strong working knowledge of insurance products and underwriting guidelines. Preference would be given to candidates who have worked with international organizations like World Bank, ADB, AFD, KFW, GIZ etc.

content_sections.heading: NABCONS Insurance Specialist Salary
content_sections.text: Salary will be commensurate based upon experience and last drawn salary. The candidates will be liable for tax liabilities under section 393(1) [Sl. No. 6(iii)D(b)] of the Income Tax Act 2025 & Rules in force and the tax will be deducted at source.

rows.pay_level_pay: Consolidated Professional Fees based on experience, educational qualification, and last drawn salary

content_sections.heading: NABCONS Insurance Specialist Selection Process
content_sections.text: The selection process includes a preliminary screening or short listing with reference to the candidate's qualification, suitability, and experience, followed by an interview and an assessment for proficiency in MS Office/data management. Merely satisfying the eligibility criteria does not entitle a candidate to be called for the interview. NABCONS reserves the right to call only the requisite number of candidates for the interview depending on the number of responses, after preliminary screening or shortlisting with reference to the candidate's qualification, suitability, and experience. Only shortlisted candidates will be called for the interview and may also be assessed for their proficiency in MS Office/data management. The interview may be held in person or through virtual mode as may be required. Location for the interview will be indicated in the call letter.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for NABCONS Insurance Specialist
content_sections.text: Visit the official NABCONS website at https://nabcons.com/ or use the direct application link provided. Read all the instructions carefully before applying to ensure eligibility. Access the online application form via the designated link. Fill in all the required details in the prescribed online format. Submit the declaration with respect to educational qualification and experience in the online form. Submit the application online on or before 13 October 2026 (Midnight). Keep a record of the submitted application details for future reference.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Self-attested copies of educational qualifications and experience certificates (to be compulsorily submitted at the time of the interview). Original documents for verification during the interview.
